name: tmc-low-current
title: TMC Low Current
author: bespoked
description: Lowers the X and Y TMC2240 run current from 1.2 to 1.0 A for less heat and quieter motion. May skip steps under heavy load or fast moves; watch for layer shifts and raise the current again if motion suffers. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
tagline: Cooler, quieter X/Y motion at reduced stepper current.
attributions:
# Attributions - tmc-low-current

**Plugin author:** @Argolein (Extended Firmware overlay `32-feature-klipper-tweaks`), packaged by Bespok3d

Lowers stepper current for quieter running.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extended Firmware overlay `32-feature-klipper-tweaks` | @Argolein, packaged by paxx12 | GPL-3.0-only | no | yes |

The Klipper config in this package is the `tmc_current.cfg` tweak from the Extended Firmware overlay
`32-feature-klipper-tweaks`, GPL-3.0-only, whose TMC driver work is credited to @Argolein. It ships
here unchanged, comments and all, and stays under that licence. The licence text and the provenance
note are in `vendor/tmc-current-tweak/` at the root of this repository.
